claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Flunarizine is a cationic amphiphilic diphenylpiperazine that at 2.5 uM most plausibly kills cells through lysosomal/phospholipidosis-type stress rather than through its annotated calcium-channel or histamine-receptor targets, which are not cytotoxic at this concentration.
